Oyster Spread
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 12:25am

Ingredients




1 pkt (8 oz) cream cheese
Mayonnaise
1 can Smoked oysters, chopped
1/2 cup Ripe olives, minced
Garlic salt
Lemon juice

Preparation

1 Cream cheese with a small amount of mayonnaise until smooth. Add smoked oysters and olives and mix well. Add garlic salt and dash of lemon juice to taste. Serve with crackers. You decide how much mayonnaise you want to use.
